summary: Turtle Beach Corp filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, announcing entry into a $85 million term loan facility with Blue Torch Finance, LLC and a separate ABL revolving credit facility. Proceeds refinance existing debt, fund general corporate purposes, and pay fees. The term loan matures April 30, 2029, with SOFR+6.75%-7.50% interest, quarterly amortization of 1.25%, and prepayment penalties. It is secured by substantially all assets and includes financial covenants. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
